mn137:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn137:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn137:2.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn137:3.1: Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni; cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā; aṭṭhādasa manopavicārā veditabbā; chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā. Tatr' idaṃ nissāya idam pajahatha. Tayo satipaṭṭhānā yad ariyo sevati, yad ariyo sevamāno Satthā gaṇam anusāsituṃ arahati. So vuccati yoggācariyānaṃ anuttaro purisadammasārathīti.

mn137:8.3: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati upekhaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati;
mn137:8.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati upekhaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati.
mn137:8.9: Iti cha somanassupavicārā cha domanassupavicārā cha upekhupavicārā. Aṭṭhādasa manopavicārā veditabbā ti
mn137:8.10: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn137:9.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paticca vuttaṃ?
mn137:9.3: Cha gehasitāni somanassāni, cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni; cha gehasitāni domanassāni, cha nekkhammasitāni domanassāni; cha gehasitā upekhā, cha nekkhammasitā upekhā.
mn137:10.2: Cakkhuviññeyyānaṃ rūpānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lokāmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ paṭilābhaṃ vā paṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā paṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati somanassaṃ;
mn137:10.3: yaṃ evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati gehasitaṃ somanassaṃ.
mn137:10.8: manoviññeyyānaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lokāmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ paṭilābhaṃ vā paṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā paṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati somanassaṃ;
mn137:10.9: yaṃ evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati gehasitaṃ somanassaṃ.
mn137:11.2: Rūpānaṃ tveva aniccataṃ viditvā vipariṇāmavirāganirodhaṃ: Pubbe c' eva rūpā etarahi ca sabbe te rūpā anicca dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato uppajjati somanassaṃ;
mn137:11.3: yaṃ evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasitaṃ somanassaṃ;
mn137:11.8: dhammānaṃ tvevā aniccataṃ viditvā vipariṇāmavirāganirodhaṃ: Pubbe c' eva dhammā etarahi ca sabbe te dhammā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato uppajjati somanassaṃ;
mn137:11.9: yaṃ evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasitaṃ somanassaṃ.
mn137:12.3: iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lokāmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ appaṭilābhaṃ vā appaṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā appaṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati domanassaṃ; yaṃ evarūpaṃ domanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati gehasitaṃ domanassaṃ.
mn137:12.8: manoviññeyyānaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lokāmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ appaṭilābhaṃ vā appaṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā appaṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati domanassaṃ;
mn137:12.9: yaṃ evarūpaṃ domanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati gehasitaṃ domanassaṃ.
mn137:13.2: Rūpānaṃ tveva aniccataṃ viditvā vipariṇāmavirāganirodhaṃ: Pubbe c' eva rūpā etarahi ca sabbe te rūpā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā anuttaresu vimokhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti:
mn137:13.3: Kadā 'ssu nām' ahaṃ tad āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yad ariyā etarahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantīti, iti anuttaresu vimokhesu pihaṃ uppaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihapaccayā domanassaṃ;
mn137:13.4: yaṃ evarūpaṃ domanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasitaṃ domanassaṃ.
mn137:13.9: dhammānaṃ tveva aniccataṃ viditvā vipariṇāmavirāganirodhaṃ: Pubbe c' eva dhammā etarahi ca sabbe te dhammā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā anuttaresu vimokhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāhāpeti: Kadā
mn137:13.10: 'ssu nām' ahaṃ tad āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yad ariyā etarahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantīti iti anuttaresu vimokhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihapaccayā domanassaṃ ;
mn137:13.11: yaṃ evarūpaṃ domanassaṃ. idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasitaṃ domanassaṃ.
mn137:14.2: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā upekhā bālassa mūḷhassa puthujjanassa anodhijinassa avipākajinassa anādīnavadassāvino assutavato puthujjanassa;
mn137:14.3: yā evarūpā upekhā, rūpaṃ sā nātivattati;
mn137:14.4: tasmā sā upekhā gehasitā ti vuccati.
mn137:14.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjati upekhā bālassa mūḷhassa puthujjanassa anodhijinassa avipākajinassa anādīnavadassāvino assutavato puthujjanassa;
mn137:14.10: yā evarūpā upekhā, dhammaṃ sā nātivattati;
mn137:14.11: tasmā sā upekhā gehasitā ti vuccati.
mn137:15.2: Rūpānaṃ tveva aniccataṃ viditvā vipariṇāmavirāganirodhaṃ: Pubbe c' eva rūpā etarahi ca sabbe te rūpā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato uppajjati upekhā;
mn137:15.3: yā evarūpā upekhā, rūpaṃ sā ativattati;
mn137:15.4: tasmā sā upekhā nekkhammasitā ti vuccati.

mn137:15.10: yā evarūpā upekhā, dhammaṃ sā ativattati;
mn137:15.14: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn137:16.2: iti kho pan etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
mn137:16.3: Tatra, bhikkhave, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni, tāni nissāya tāni āgamma, yāni cha gehasitāni somanassāni, tāni pajahatha tāni samatikkamatha;
mn137:16.4: evam etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti; evam etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.
mn137:16.5: Tatra, bhikkhave, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni domanassāni, tāni nissāya tāni āgamma, yāni cha gehasitāni domanassāni, tāni pajahatha tāni samatikkamatha;
mn137:16.6: evam etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti; evam etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.
mn137:16.7: Tatra, bhikkhave, yā cha nekkhammasitā upekhā, tā nissāya tā āgamma, yā cha gehasitā upekhā, tā pajahatha, tā samatikkamatha;
mn137:16.8: evam etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti; evam etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.
mn137:16.9: Tatra, bhikkhave, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni, tāni nissāya tāni āgamma, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni domanassāni, tāni pajahatha tāni samatikkamatha;
mn137:16.10: evam etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti; evam etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.
mn137:16.11: Tatra, bhikkhave, yā cha nekkhammasitā upekhā, tā nissāya tā āgamma, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni, tāni pajahatha tāni samatikkamatha:
mn137:16.12: evam etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti; evam etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.
mn137:17.1: Atthi, bhikkhave, upekhā nānattā nānattasitā; atthi upekhā ekattā ekattasitā.
mn137:18.1: Katamā ca, bhikkhave, upekhā nānattā nāttasitā?
mn137:18.2: Atthi, bhikkhave, upekhā rūpesu, atthi saddesu, atthi gandhesu, atthi rasesu, atthi phoṭṭhabbesu.
mn137:19.1: Katamā ca, bhikkhave, upekhā ekattā ekattasitā?
mn137:19.2: Atthi, bhikkhave, upekhā ākāsānañcāyatananissitā; atthi viññāṇañcāyatananissitā; atthi ākiñcaññāyatananissitā; atthi nevasaññānāsaññāyatananissitā.
mn137:20.1: Tatra, bhikkhave, yāyaṃ upekhā ekattā ekattasitā, taṃ nissāya taṃ āgamma, yāyaṃ upekhā nānattā nānattasitā, taṃ pajahatha taṃ samatikkamatha;
mn137:20.2: evam etissā pahānaṃ hoti; evam etissā samatikkamo hoti.
mn137:20.3: Atammayataṃ, bhikkhave, nissāya atammayataṃ āgamma, yāyaṃ upekhā ekattā ekattasitā, taṃ pajahatha taṃ samatikkamatha;
mn137:20.4: evam etissā pahānaṃ hoti; evam etissā samatikkamo hoti.
mn137:20.6: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn137:21.1: Tayo satipaṭṭhānā yad ariyo sevati yad' ariyo sevamāno satthā gaṇam anusāsituṃ arahatīti
mn137:22.1: Idha, bhikkhave, satthā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti anukampako hitesī anukampaṃ upādāya:
mn137:22.2: Idaṃ vo hitāya idaṃ vo sukhāyāti.
mn137:22.3: Tassa sāvakā na sussūyanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti, vokkamma ca satthu sāsanā vattanti.
mn137:22.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, Tathāgato na c' eva attamano hoti na ca attamanataṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, anavassuto ca viharati sato sampajāno.
mn137:22.5: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ yad ariyo sevati yad ariyo sevamāno satthā gaṇam anusāsituṃ arahati.
mn137:23.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, satthā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti anukampako hitesī anukampaṃ upādāya;
mn137:23.2: Idaṃ vo hitāya idaṃ vo sukhāyāti.
mn137:23.3: Tassa ekacce sāvakā na sussūyanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti, vokkamma ca satthu sāsanā vattanti.
mn137:23.4: Ekacce sāvakā sussūyanti sotaṃ odahanti añña cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti na ca vokkamma satthu sāsanā vattanti.
mn137:23.5: Tatra, bhikkhave, Tathāgato na c' eva attamano hoti na ca attamanataṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, na ca anattamano hoti na ca anattamanataṃ paṭisaṃvedeti;
mn137:23.8: tad ubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā so upekhako viharati sato sampajāno.
mn137:23.9: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ yad . . . arahati.
mn137:24.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, satthā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti . . .
mn137:24.3: Tassa sāvakā sussūyanti sotaṃ odahanti aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti na ca vokkamma satthu sāsanā vattanti.
mn137:24.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, Tathāgato attamano c' eva hoti attamanatañ ca paṭisaṃvedeti anavassuto ca viharati sato sampajāno.
mn137:24.5: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ yad . . . arahati.
mn137:24.6: Tayo satipaṭṭhānā yad ariyo sevati yad ariyo sevamano satthā gaṇam anusāsituṃ arahatīti
mn137:24.7: iti taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn137:25.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
mn137:25.3: Hatthidamakena, bhikkhave, hatthidammo sārito ekaṃ yeva disaṃ dhāvati, --
mn137:25.4: puratthimaṃ vā pacchimaṃ vā uttaraṃ vā dakkhīṇaṃ vā.
mn137:26.1: Assadammakena, bhikkhave, assadammo sārito ekaṃ yeva disaṃ . . .
mn137:26.5: Tathāgatena, bhikkhave, arahatā sammāsambuddhena purisadammo sārito aṭṭha disā vidhāvati.
mn137:27.7: Sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā, nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā: Ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajjā viharati;
mn137:27.9: Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma: Anantaṃ viññāṇan ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati;
mn137:27.11: Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma: Na 'tthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati;
mn137:27.13: Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati;
mn137:27.15: Sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati;
mn137:27.17: Tathāgatena, bhikkhave, arahatā sammāsambuddhena purisadammo sārito imā aṭṭha disā vidhāvati.
mn137:28.2: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttan ti.
